avoidWhen.text: Avoid flashing a spinner or plan tracker for instant operations that settle synchronously.

customize.text: Use a concise status line for loading frames (such as Loam's loam-view-frame) or a step list when a plan has multiple steps.

keep.text: Exposes pending work or plan progress through role status or progressbar.
Fits a narrow viewport without horizontal overflow.
When a plan includes completed, in-progress, or failed steps, name each step and its current state clearly.

default.text: Mount a pending or multi-step plan state from spec/wire/result-success-full.json (or Loam's ViewFrameLoading) with role status or progressbar.

summary: Show pending work and multi-step plan status in an accessible status or progressbar region without stealing focus.

useWhen.text: Use when a command is running asynchronously, loading screen data, or returns a multi-step plan.
